current.EN: Useful only for cooking, can't get high enough temperature to smelt anything inside.
current.PTBR: Útil apenas para cozinhar, não atinge temperatura alta o suficiente para fundir nada lá dentro.

current.EN: The fibers from the nettle plant can be harvested and spun into thread suitable for making clothes.
current.PTBR: As fibras da planta de urtiga podem ser colhidas e fiadas em fios adequados para fazer roupas.

current.EN: Nettle thread is produced from nettle and is used in crafting of various clothing.
current.PTBR: O fio de urtiga é produzido a partir de urtiga e usado na confecção de diversas vestimentas.

current.EN: Lightweight, soft and durable cloth woven from cotton.
current.PTBR: Tecido leve, macio e durável, feito de algodão.

current.EN: This is part of the magical elder tree inside of the elven keep of Anheluna.
current.PTBR: Isto é parte da árvore ancestral mágica no interior da fortaleza élfica de Anheluna.

current.EN: Just a small body of standing water.
current.PTBR: Apenas um pequeno corpo de água parada.
Vinho de maçã amado pelos elfos.

current.EN: A tree that grows apples, often seen in elven gardens.
current.PTBR: Uma árvore que produz maçãs, frequentemente vista em jardins élficos.

current.EN: This weapon has a distinct curved blade, sharpened on the outside edge. It's designed for both chopping and slashing.
current.PTBR: Esta arma possui uma lâmina curva distinta, afiada no fio externo. Projetada para cortar e fender.

current.EN: Gate made of torns magicaly bound together, blocking the way.
current.PTBR: Portão feito de espinhos magicamente unidos, bloqueando o caminho.

current.EN: Thorns are at the sides allowing passage.
current.PTBR: Os espinhos estão nas laterais, permitindo a passagem.

current.EN: Mace on a metal hilt with a scale pommel.
current.PTBR: Maça com cabo de metal e pomo de escama.

current.EN: This axe is designed for use in beheadings. It has a large, heavy blade, allowing for a more precise and efficient strike. The blade is mounted on a long wooden handle, which enables the executioner to deliver a decisive blow with both hands.
current.PTBR: Este machado foi projetado para uso em decapitações. Possui uma lâmina grande e pesada, permitindo um golpe mais preciso e eficiente. A lâmina está montada em um cabo de madeira longo, o que permite que o carrasco desfeche um golpe decisivo com ambas as mãos.

current.EN: This blade was made from the bones of powerful beasts, expertly crafted and sharpened to a razor's edge. The dagger's hilt is adorned with intricate runes and symbols, which are said to grant the wielder supernatural abilities and protection.
current.PTBR: Esta lâmina foi feita dos ossos de bestas poderosas, trabalhada com maestria e afiada até o fio de uma navalha. O cabo da adaga é adornado com runas e símbolos intrincados, que dizem conceder ao portador habilidades sobrenaturais e proteção.

current.EN: This snake sword made by elven smiths is a truly unique weapon designed to strike fear into the hearts of the wielder's enemies. The blade is characterized by a distinctive wavy pattern resembling a snake's movement.
current.PTBR: Esta espada serpente feita por ferreiros élficos é uma arma verdadeiramente única projetada para incutir medo nos corações dos inimigos do portador. A lâmina é caracterizada por um padrão ondulado distinto que lembra o movimento de uma cobra.

current.EN: This devastating weapon is designed for heavy, crushing blows. It consists of a large metal head mounted on a long wooden handle.
current.PTBR: Esta arma devastadora foi projetada para golpes pesados e esmagadores. Consiste em uma grande cabeça de metal montada em um cabo de madeira longo.

current.EN: The blade of this axe is expertly sharpened and honed to a razor's edge, making it capable of delivering devastating blows to even the most heavily-armored opponents.
current.PTBR: A lâmina deste machado é expertamente afiada e amolada até um fio de navalha, tornando-o capaz de desferir golpes devastadores até mesmo nos oponentes mais pesadamente blindados.

current.EN: This blade is designed specifically for stealth and quick kills. Its slender, pointed blade allows it to pierce through flesh and bone easily.
current.PTBR: Esta lâmina foi projetada especificamente para furtividade e mortes rápidas. Sua lâmina estreita e pontiaguda permite perfurar carne e osso facilmente.

current.EN: This axe features a sharp, heavy blade with jagged bone protrusions on the back. The handle is adorned with carvings and additional bones for a secure grip. It's a highly effective combat weapon, capable of slicing through armor and bone.
current.PTBR: Este machado possui uma lâmina afiada e pesada com projeções ósseas serrilhadas na parte traseira. O cabo é adornado com entalhes e ossos adicionais para uma empunhadura segura. É uma arma de combate altamente eficaz, capaz de fender armadura e osso.

current.EN: A short, ornate blade with intricate engravings of symbols of power. It features a bone handle encrusted with precious stones and a deadly blade ideal for close combat.
current.PTBR: Uma lâmina curta e ornamentada com gravuras intrincadas de símbolos de poder. Possui um cabo de osso incrustado com pedras preciosas e uma lâmina mortal ideal para combate próximo.

current.EN: These leg armor pieces cover the shin.
current.PTBR: Estas peças de armadura de perna cobrem a canela.

current.EN: These blue flames dancing above the ground are spirits of the forest.
current.PTBR: Estas chamas azuis dançando acima do solo são espíritos da floresta.

current.EN: The cloak is made from high-quality leather that is lightweight, durable, and easy to move. It also features pockets for storing essential items, making it an ideal accessory for rangers who spend extended periods in the wilderness.
current.PTBR: A capa é feita de couro de alta qualidade, leve, durável e que permite fácil movimento. Também possui bolsos para guardar itens essenciais, tornando-a um acessório ideal para rangers que passam longos períodos na natureza selvagem.

current.EN: A large, oval-shaped shield made of animal hide hardened with animal fat and charcoal.
current.PTBR: Um grande escudo oval feito de pele animal endurecida com gordura animal e carvão.

current.EN: Gloves made of leather with metal spikes attached to the knuckles.
current.PTBR: Luvas feitas de couro com espinhos de metal presos aos nós dos dedos.

current.EN: A flowing robe made from supple and soft leather, designed to be worn by rangers and scouts who traverse the forests and wilderness. The leather is treated with a unique blend of oils and herbs, making it durable and weather-resistant yet still flexible and comfortable.
current.PTBR: Uma túnica fluida feita de couro flexível e macio, projetada para ser usada por rangers e batedores que percorrem florestas e áreas selvagens. O couro é tratado com uma mistura única de óleos e ervas, tornando-o durável e resistente às intempéries, mas ainda flexível e confortável.

current.EN: This garb is a patchwork of various furs and hides, adorned with bones and feathers, and has a distinctly wild and primal look.
current.PTBR: Esta vestimenta é um retalho de várias peles e couros, adornada com ossos e penas, e tem uma aparência distintamente selvagem e primitiva.

current.EN: A hooded, long coat made from animal fur. It's designed to provide warmth and protection from the elements.
current.PTBR: Um casaco longo com capuz feito de pele de animal. Projetado para fornecer calor e proteção contra as intempéries.

current.EN: Sturdy and rugged boots yet comfortable to wear. The thick fur lining keeps the feet warm and protected from the harsh winter elements.
current.PTBR: Botas robustas e rústicas, mas confortáveis de usar. O forro de pele grosso mantém os pés quentes e protegidos dos rigores do inverno.

current.EN: A bizarrely looking mask made of roughly stiched together pieces of leather.
current.PTBR: Uma máscara de aparência bizarra feita de pedaços de couro costurados grosseiramente.

current.EN: Short cloak made of animal fur. It provides warmth and protection from the elements and is often worn by hunters and travelers in colder climates.
current.PTBR: Manto curto feito de pele de animal. Proporciona calor e proteção contra as intempéries e é frequentemente usado por caçadores e viajantes em climas mais frios.

current.EN: Looks like a quick way up, if you don't mind risking your life on fraying ropes.
current.PTBR: Parece um jeito rápido de subir, se você não se importar de arriscar a vida em cordas desgastadas.

current.EN: The only quicker way down is by falling.
current.PTBR: A única maneira mais rápida de descer é caindo.
A beleza da natureza sob seus pés.

current.EN: A string of smelly dried fish is hanging on two sticks.
current.PTBR: Uma fileira de peixes secos fedidos está pendurada em dois paus.

current.EN: Broken and lifeless corpse of a cat-like humanoid creature.
current.PTBR: Cadáver quebrado e sem vida de uma criatura humanoide felina.

current.EN: Tough, durable fibers harvested from cacti, used for crafting sturdy pieces of clothing.
current.PTBR: Fibras resistentes e duráveis colhidas de cactos, usadas para confeccionar peças de roupa robustas.

current.EN: Strong, versatile fibers extracted from fan leaves of the palm trees.
current.PTBR: Fibras fortes e versáteis extraídas das folhas em leque das palmeiras.

current.EN: A belt-like garment worn around the waist.
current.PTBR: Uma vestimenta semelhante a um cinto, usada na cintura.

current.EN: Lightweight cloak offering excellent protection from nature.
current.PTBR: Manto leve que oferece excelente proteção contra a natureza.

current.EN: A cape made of bones and feathers.
current.PTBR: Uma capa feita de ossos e penas.

current.EN: Unique shoes with an elongated toe box for precise movement, often worn by acrobats.
current.PTBR: Sapatos únicos com bico alongado para movimento preciso, frequentemente usados por acrobatas.

current.EN: Cloth gloves imbued with magical properties to enhance your capabilities.
current.PTBR: Luvas de tecido imbuídas com propriedades mágicas para aprimorar suas capacidades.

current.EN: A magical carpet capable of flight, controlled by the rider's will. It can take you anywhere in the world, soaring over mountains and seas with ease.
current.PTBR: Um tapete mágico capaz de voar, controlado pela vontade do cavaleiro. Pode levá-lo a qualquer lugar do mundo, sobrevoando montanhas e mares com facilidade.

current.EN: A beautifully crafted stringed instrument with a wooden body and intricate carvings.
current.PTBR: Um instrumento de cordas lindamente trabalhado, com corpo de madeira e entalhes intrincados.

current.EN: A wooden mannequin used by medieval tailors to design and create clothing, allowing for precise measurements and fittings for garments ranging from simple tunics to ornate gowns.
current.PTBR: Um manequim de madeira usado por alfaiates medievais para projetar e criar roupas, permitindo medidas e ajustes precisos para peças que vão de túnicas simples a vestidos ornamentados.

current.EN: A sturdy shield made of overlapping metal scales, offering excellent protection against slashing attacks while still being light enough to wield in battle.
current.PTBR: Um escudo robusto feito de escamas metálicas sobrepostas, oferecendo excelente proteção contra ataques de corte, enquanto ainda é leve o suficiente para ser empunhado em batalha.

current.EN: Elaborate bracers adorned with intricate elven motifs, crafted with great care and attention to detail.
current.PTBR: Braçadeiras elaboradas adornadas com motivos élficos intrincados, confeccionadas com grande cuidado e atenção aos detalhes.

current.EN: Leg armor crafted from interlocking scales, offering reliable protection against piercing attacks.
current.PTBR: Armadura de perna feita de escamas entrelaçadas, oferecendo proteção confiável contra ataques perfurantes.

current.EN: Greaves made from hardened bone, often worn by bone wraiths to showcase their ferocity and brutality.
current.PTBR: Grevas feitas de osso endurecido, frequentemente usadas por espectros ósseos para exibir sua ferocidade e brutalidade.

current.EN: Loose heavy pants offering decent protection.
current.PTBR: Calças pesadas e folgadas que oferecem proteção decente.

current.EN: Lifeless body of a Bone Wraith.
Sturdy bracers made of interlocking scales, designed to protect the wearer's forearms and wrists.
current.PTBR: Braçadeiras robustas feitas de escamas entrelaçadas, projetadas para proteger os antebraços e pulsos do usuário.

current.EN: A hard, brown, tropical fruit with a fibrous outer layer and a white, edible interior.
current.PTBR: Uma fruta tropical dura, marrom, com uma camada externa fibrosa e um interior branco e comestível.

current.EN: An edible root found in the dense jungles.
current.PTBR: Uma raiz comestível encontrada nas densas selvas.

current.EN: Fine powder made from pulverized bones.
current.PTBR: Pó fino feito de ossos pulverizados.

current.EN: A bone infused with grains of sand through a mysterious ritual performed by bone wraiths.
current.PTBR: Um osso infundido com grãos de areia através de um ritual misterioso realizado por espectros de osso.

current.EN: Some hay on the floor, a resting place of the poor.
current.PTBR: Um pouco de feno no chão, um local de descanso dos pobres.

current.EN: A slimy, primitive cave dweller. He has a keen sense of smell and sees very well in the dark. His skin is dirty green.
current.PTBR: Um habitante de caverna viscoso e primitivo. Ele tem um olfato aguçado e enxerga muito bem no escuro. Sua pele é verde suja.

current.EN: This is a dirty and stinking piece of cloth, tattered and torn in multiple places.
current.PTBR: Este é um pedaço de tecido sujo e fedorento, esfarrapado e rasgado em vários lugares.

current.EN: A table carved from a hard shell of some beast.
current.PTBR: Mesa esculpida na carapaça dura de alguma fera.

current.EN: Pillow stuffed with some fabric. Its plump shape provides gentle support for the head and neck, ensuring a comfortable night's sleep. It's used without the need to drop it on the ground.
current.PTBR: Travesseiro recheado com algum tecido. Seu formato fofinho proporciona apoio suave para a cabeça e o pescoço, garantindo uma noite de sono confortável. É usado sem precisar colocá-lo no chão.

current.EN: This unique chair is crafted from large shell pieces, providing a sturdy and strikingly textured seat. The chair's curved back and broad base provide ample support and comfort, while its iridescent surface shimmers in the light.
current.PTBR: Esta cadeira única é feita de grandes pedaços de carapaça, fornecendo um assento resistente e com textura marcante. O encosto curvo e a base larga oferecem amplo suporte e conforto, enquanto sua superfície iridescente brilha na luz.

current.EN: Roof made out of sandstone blocks.
Wall made of polished and cut sandstone blocks.
current.PTBR: Parede feita de blocos de arenito polido e cortado.

current.EN: This sweet and chewy fruit is the perfect snack for a traveler on the go.
current.PTBR: Esta fruta doce e mastigável é o lanche perfeito para um viajante apressado.

current.EN: A table made of carved shells and scales, covered with weird vials and reagents.
current.PTBR: Uma mesa feita de conchas e escamas esculpidas, coberta com frascos estranhos e reagentes.

current.EN: This large, blackened cauldron is made entirely of interlocking bones bound together with shells. Bone wraiths use it in a dark and mysterious ritual to create new beings of their own kind. The cauldron's interior is filled with a steaming, bubbling liquid that emits a spicy, earthy aroma. Bones and other mysterious ingredients are thrown into the cauldron, where they are boiled during the ritual creating new bone wraiths.
current.PTBR: Este grande caldeirão enegrecido é feito inteiramente de ossos entrelaçados unidos por conchas. Os espectros ósseos o usam em um ritual sombrio e misterioso para criar novos seres de sua espécie. O interior do caldeirão está cheio de um líquido fervilhante e fumegante que exala um aroma picante e terroso. Ossos e outros ingredientes misteriosos são jogados no caldeirão, onde são fervidos durante o ritual criando novos espectros ósseos.

current.EN: You see a giant snake with a woman torso and head. From time to time, she hisses at you, showing her split tongue. The hair that falls on her shoulders reseble seaweed.
current.PTBR: Você vê uma cobra gigante com torso e cabeça de mulher. De vez em quando, ela sibila para você, mostrando sua língua bifurcada. O cabelo que cai sobre seus ombros lembra algas marinhas.

current.EN: Device used to spin thread or yarn made of interconnected shells and scales. Used to create cloth material.
current.PTBR: Dispositivo usado para fiar fios ou lãs feitos de conchas e escamas interconectadas. Usado para criar tecidos.

current.EN: This ornate treasure chest, adorned with intricate carvings and gleaming metalwork, harbors a trove of precious secrets, awaiting the thrill of discovery by those bold enough to unlock its mysteries.
current.PTBR: Este baú do tesouro ornamentado, adornado com entalhes intrincados e metalurgia brilhante, guarda um tesouro de segredos preciosos, aguardando a emoção da descoberta por aqueles ousados o suficiente para desvendar seus mistérios.

current.EN: Nestled within a sturdy sandstone wall, this open window offers a glimpse into the boundless desert, inviting in the sun's warmth and the gentle whisper of the wind through the sands.
current.PTBR: Aninhada em uma resistente parede de arenito, esta janela aberta oferece um vislumbre do deserto sem limites, convidando o calor do sol e o suave sussurro do vento através das areias.

current.EN: This exquisite sandstone-framed window, fitted with shimmering glass, captures the essence of the desert landscape, inviting the golden warmth and tranquil beauty of the dunes into your space.
current.PTBR: Esta requintada janela com moldura de arenito, equipada com vidro cintilante, captura a essência da paisagem desértica, convidando o calor dourado e a beleza tranquila das dunas para o seu espaço.

current.EN: Fashioned by the enigmatic Bone Wraiths, this striking door is a mosaic of sun-bleached shells, reflecting the tribe's nomadic spirit and their deep connection to the arid sands.
current.PTBR: Forjada pelos enigmáticos Espectros Ósseos, esta porta impressionante é um mosaico de conchas branqueadas pelo sol, refletindo o espírito nômade da tribo e sua profunda conexão com as areias áridas.

current.EN: These outstretched tree branches, still connected to their mighty trunk, offer shade and shelter, while harboring the potential for countless future crafts and endeavors.
current.PTBR: Estes galhos de árvore estendidos, ainda ligados ao seu tronco poderoso, oferecem sombra e abrigo, enquanto guardam o potencial para incontáveis artesanatos e empreendimentos futuros.

current.EN: A vibrant assortment of spices, bursting with flavors and aromas that transport taste buds on a thrilling culinary journey to distant, undiscovered lands.
current.PTBR: Um sortimento vibrante de especiarias, repleto de sabores e aromas que levam o paladar a uma emocionante jornada culinária a terras distantes e inexploradas.

current.EN: This sweet and fragrant orchid nectar, carefully collected from delicate blossoms, holds the essence of nature's beauty in every tantalizing drop.
current.PTBR: Este néctar de orquídea doce e fragrante, cuidadosamente coletado de flores delicadas, guarda a essência da beleza da natureza em cada gota tentadora.

current.EN: This resilient turtle shell, a testament to the wonders of the natural world, once safeguarded its original owner and now awaits a new purpose in skillful hands.
current.PTBR: Esta carapaça de tartaruga resiliente, um testamento às maravilhas do mundo natural, já protegeu seu dono original e agora aguarda um novo propósito em mãos hábeis.

current.EN: A wall of easy to dig dirt.
current.PTBR: Uma parede de terra fácil de cavar.

current.EN: This well-worn chopping block has seen countless logs cleaved by the skilled hands of woodcutters, transforming raw timber into fuel for life's necessities.
current.PTBR: Este bloco de corte bem gasto já viu incontáveis toras fendidas pelas mãos habilidosas de lenhadores, transformando madeira bruta em combustível para as necessidades da vida.

current.EN: This sturdy net ensnares foes with ruthless efficiency, leaving them helplessly entwined in its unforgiving grasp.
current.PTBR: Esta rede robusta prende inimigos com eficiência implacável, deixando-os impotentes e enredados em seu domínio implacável.

current.EN: Gently smoldering, this stick of incense releases a captivating scent that calms the senses and adds an air of mystique to its surroundings.
current.PTBR: Queimando suavemente, este bastão de incenso libera um aroma cativante que acalma os sentidos e adiciona um ar de mistério ao ambiente.

current.EN: This imposing palisade, constructed from sturdy timber stakes, offers a line of defense against unwanted intruders and the perils of the wild.
current.PTBR: Esta paliçada imponente, construída com estacas de madeira robustas, oferece uma linha de defesa contra intrusos indesejados e os perigos da natureza selvagem.

current.EN: A long, forked tongue from a cobra's mouth, used for precise striking and delivering venom.
current.PTBR: Uma língua longa e bifurcada da boca de uma cobra, usada para golpes precisos e inoculação de veneno.

current.EN: A lifeless body of a cobra.
current.PTBR: Um corpo sem vida de uma cobra.

current.EN: A venomous serpent known for its hooded appearance and menacing hiss.
current.PTBR: Uma serpente venenosa conhecida por sua aparência encapuzada e chiado ameaçador.

current.EN: A root with mystical properties found in swamps.
current.PTBR: Uma raiz com propriedades místicas encontrada em pântanos.

current.EN: A cold wall constructed from stone blocks. It's quite durable.
current.PTBR: Uma parede fria construída com blocos de pedra. É bastante durável.

current.EN: This is a stone wall, old and broken by time.
current.PTBR: Esta é uma parede de pedra, velha e quebrada pelo tempo.

current.EN: A cursed relic pulsating with dark energy. Its whispers carry a malevolent influence, tempting the wielder into a treacherous dance with forbidden forces.
current.PTBR: Uma relíquia amaldiçoada pulsando com energia sombria. Seus sussurros carregam uma influência malévola, tentando o portador para uma dança traiçoeira com forças proibidas.

current.EN: A mystical ingredient from the heart of the jungle. This potent essence, harvested from the thorned flora, pulses with magic.
current.PTBR: Um ingrediente místico do coração da selva. Essa essência potente, colhida da flora espinhosa, pulsa com magia.

current.EN: A shimmering gem born of frigid realms, crystallizing the essence of ice and cold. This exquisite crystal radiates an icy blue glow, holding within it the raw power of frost.
current.PTBR: Uma joia cintilante nascida de reinos gélidos, cristalizando a essência do gelo e do frio. Este cristal requintado irradia um brilho azul gelado, contendo em si o poder bruto da Geada.

current.EN: A delicate and luminescent flora that thrives under the gentle touch of moonlight.
current.PTBR: Uma flora delicada e luminosa que prospera sob o toque suave do luar.

current.EN: A vile and putrid substance, the essence of the accursed undead. This sickly green ichor oozes with decay and corruption, a testament to the foul nature of the ghouls.
current.PTBR: Uma substância vil e pútrida, a essência dos mortos-vivos amaldiçoados. Este ícor verde-doentio exala decomposição e corrupção, um testemunho da natureza hedionda dos necrófagos.

current.EN: A rugged and resilient scale shed by the reptilian warriors of the swamplands. These scales boast a natural armor-like quality, forged through generations of adaptation.
current.PTBR: Uma escama rugosa e resistente, perdida pelos guerreiros reptilianos das terras pantanosas. Essas escamas ostentam uma qualidade natural de armadura, forjada através de gerações de adaptação.

current.EN: This stone wall is an illusion! You might be able to pass through, but its impossible to know what dangers lurk behind it.
current.PTBR: Esta parede de pedra é uma ilusão! Você pode ser capaz de passar por ela, mas é impossível saber quais perigos se escondem atrás dela.

current.EN: The lifeless remains of a fearsome reptilian warrior, now a testament to its demise.
current.PTBR: Os restos inanimados de um temível guerreiro réptil, agora um testamento de sua morte.

current.EN: This grotesque cadaver exudes an overpowering stench of decay, and its flesh is mottled with rot and decay.
current.PTBR: Este cadáver grotesco exala um cheiro avassalador de decomposição, e sua carne é manchada por podridão e decomposição.

current.EN: There are many useful tools you could carry on your travels - knives to scavenge corpses, pickaxes to mine ores and gems, woodcutters to gather rare wood, harvesters to acquire wheat and herbs. Find a Toolmaker in Human, Dwarf or Bone Wraith settlement and order one. Plunder more chests along the way if you lack funds.
current.PTBR: Há muitas ferramentas úteis que você pode carregar em suas viagens - facas para saquear cadáveres, picaretas para minerar minérios e gemas, machados para coletar madeira rara, foices para obter trigo e ervas. Encontre um Ferramenteiro em um assentamento Humano, Anão ou de Espectros de Osso e encomende uma. Saqueie mais baús pelo caminho se lhe faltarem fundos.

current.EN: Until we learn from experienced characters, our potential to master a skill is limited. Let's try to find a trainer and pay them to teach us some new theories about our chosen skill.
current.PTBR: Até aprendermos com personagens experientes, nosso potencial para dominar uma perícia é limitado. Vamos tentar encontrar um instrutor e pagá-lo para nos ensinar algumas novas teorias sobre nossa perícia escolhida.

current.EN: As you explore the world, you might have noticed only easy locations pop up during your travels. To have an easier time finding more challenging areas, you'll need to train one of the combat skills, like Sword, Mace, or Axe Fighting, Pyromancy, or Thievery. Train one of those and acquire more equipment to prepare.
current.PTBR: Ao explorar o mundo, você pode ter notado que apenas locais fáceis aparecem durante suas viagens. Para ter mais facilidade em encontrar áreas mais desafiadoras, você precisará treinar uma das perícias de combate, como Combate com Espada, Maça ou Machado, Piromania ou Furto. Treine uma delas e adquira mais equipamentos para se preparar.

current.EN: It's time to pick up a new challenge, let's try finding a Troublesome special location, and loot it of all it's treasures. Make sure to have at least a knife with you, you don't want to waste precious resources from rare beasts, do you?
current.PTBR: É hora de encarar um novo desafio, vamos tentar encontrar um local especial Problemático e saquear todos os seus tesouros. Certifique-se de ter pelo menos uma faca com você, você não quer desperdiçar recursos preciosos de bestas raras, quer?

current.EN: As you loot chests, explore the world, and scavenge beasts and monsters, surely you've come across magical ingredients? It's time to put them to good use, let's find a weaponsmith, tailor, leatherworker or armorsmith who knows how to craft one of our items and order an upgrade.
current.PTBR: Ao saquear baús, explorar o mundo e revistar bestas e monstros, certamente você já encontrou ingredientes mágicos? É hora de colocá-los em bom uso. Vamos encontrar um armeiro, alfaiate, curtidor ou armoreiro que saiba como criar um de nossos itens e encomendar uma melhoria.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Humans were the most common being in the world once, but these days are long gone. The population decimated by constant wars is now just a shadow of its former glory. Representatives of this race are extremely adaptable to the situation, but their history was marked heavily by external influence. As the War of Worlds has ended, a great empire has been formed, where single human family clings to the seat of power to this day.[/color]

All statistics +1
Gets hungry 50% slower

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Dark dwarves are a subrace of dwarves completely corrupted by greed. They prefer to build their incredible keeps very deep below the ground or near volcanoes. Beings of these race are known for being cruel and malevolent.[/color]

Willpower +2
Infravision: see in the dark.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Goblins are small greenskin creatures known for their ruthlessness. Some say they are shorter orc cousins. They form tribes and prefer to live in the mountains. Their greed pushes them to challenge dwarves for their territory constantly. From time to time, they organize in hordes that swarm even the human empire.[/color]

Dexterity +3, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sneaking +10

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]A long time ago dark elves were living in the forests with their brethren, but they were corrupted by dark gods. Now they occupy huge underground cities. Their controversial religious practices and rituals make them feared and dreaded. They despise most other races for opposing their rightful place among them.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Intelligence +1, Willpower +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sight range +1

race.name: Dark elf

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. They feed by drinking the blood of the living to sustain their immortal bodies. Vampires have formed an enclave in the ruins of Black Sun Castle, where they scheme to take over the world and enslave the living like cattle.[/color]

Strength +1, Endurance +2, Intelligence +1
Thirst and hunger is replaced by bloodlust.
Infravision: see in the dark.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Trolls are huge humanoid beasts. Not many beings of this race are considered smart, but they make up for it with brutal, physical power. Trolls have the strength to tear smaller beings apart in the blink of an eye. They are forever hungry and possess very potent regenerative powers.[/color]

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Orcs are green. Orcs are mean. Orcs want to smash, bash and eat. They form hordes led by the most brutal chieftains of their kind to raid other races for loot. Their physical appearance is second only to trolls and giants.[/color]

Strength +2, Endurance +2
Hit bonus +1 on all weapons

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. Their center of power is in the Black Pyramid of Sareth where God Pharaoh Sandaver rules over the dead. The power that allows these beings to defy death is shrouded in mystery.[/color]

Intelligence +2, Willpower +2
Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. They live deep in the jungles of Tar'Var. They are individuals, loners and prefer seclusion over contact with others, as they considering other races untrustworthy. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

[color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

[color=155,155,155,255]Goblins are small greenskin creatures known for their ruthlessness. Some say they are shorter orc cousins. They form tribes and prefer to live in the mountains. Their greed pushes them to challenge dwarves for their territory constantly. From time to time, they organize in hordes that swarm even the human empire.[/color]

Dexterity +3, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sneaking +10

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]A long time ago dark elves were living in the forests with their brethren, but they were corrupted by dark gods. Now they occupy huge underground cities. Their controversial religious practices and rituals make them feared and dreaded. They despise most other races for opposing their rightful place among them.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Intelligence +1, Willpower +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sight range +1

race.name: Dark elf

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. They feed by drinking the blood of the living to sustain their immortal bodies. Vampires have formed an enclave in the ruins of Black Sun Castle, where they scheme to take over the world and enslave the living like cattle.[/color]

Strength +1, Endurance +2, Intelligence +1
Thirst and hunger is replaced by bloodlust.
Infravision: see in the dark.

[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Cloak
race.name: Vampire

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Trolls are huge humanoid beasts. Not many beings of this race are considered smart, but they make up for it with brutal, physical power. Trolls have the strength to tear smaller beings apart in the blink of an eye. They are forever hungry and possess very potent regenerative powers.[/color]

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Club
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Club
race.name: Troll

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Orcs are green. Orcs are mean. Orcs want to smash, bash and eat. They form hordes led by the most brutal chieftains of their kind to raid other races for loot. Their physical appearance is second only to trolls and giants.[/color]

Strength +2, Endurance +2
Hit bonus +1 on all weapons

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Hand axe
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Hatchet
race.name: Orc

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. Their center of power is in the Black Pyramid of Sareth where God Pharaoh Sandaver rules over the dead. The power that allows these beings to defy death is shrouded in mystery.[/color]

Intelligence +2, Willpower +2
Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Quarterstaff
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Mask
race.name: Lich

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. They live deep in the jungles of Tar'Var. They are individuals, loners and prefer seclusion over contact with others, as they considering other races untrustworthy. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

Gets hungry 50% slower

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Humans were the most common being in the world once, but these days are long gone. The population decimated by constant wars is now just a shadow of its former glory. Representatives of this race are extremely adaptable to the situation, but their history was marked heavily by external influence. As the War of Worlds has ended, a great empire has been formed, where single human family clings to the seat of power to this day.[/color]

All statistics +1
Gets hungry 50% slower

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]A long time ago dark elves were living in the forests with their brethren, but they were corrupted by dark gods. Now they occupy huge underground cities. race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. They feed by drinking the blood of the living to sustain their immortal bodies. Vampires have formed an enclave in the ruins of Black Sun Castle, where they scheme to take over the world and enslave the living like cattle.[/color]

Strength +1, Endurance +2, Intelligence +1
Thirst and hunger is replaced by bloodlust.
Infravision: see in the dark.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Trolls are huge humanoid beasts. Not many beings of this race are considered smart, but they make up for it with brutal, physical power. Trolls have the strength to tear smaller beings apart in the blink of an eye. They are forever hungry and possess very potent regenerative powers.[/color]

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

[color=155,155,155,255]Orcs are green. Orcs are mean. Orcs want to smash, bash and eat. They form hordes led by the most brutal chieftains of their kind to raid other races for loot. Their physical appearance is second only to trolls and giants.[/color]

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. Their center of power is in the Black Pyramid of Sareth where God Pharaoh Sandaver rules over the dead. The power that allows these beings to defy death is shrouded in mystery.[/color]

Intelligence +2, Willpower +2
Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. They live deep in the jungles of Tar'Var. They are individuals, loners and prefer seclusion over contact with others, as they considering other races untrustworthy. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

[color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

current.EN:
[color=192,176,27,255]Stamina[/color] is the yellow bar and describes short term energy, how much a character can do before before taking a short rest. If your stamina drops too low, you can press '[color=207,192,178,255]r[/color]' to spend a little time regaining it.

[color=176,101,43,255]Fatigue[/color] is the orange bar and it describes long term energy loss, it is increased when character regains stamina through resting. To reduce fatigue, character will have to sleep, preferably in bed, by pressing '[color=207,192,178,255]R[/color]'. If fatigue goes up to 100, the character will lose consciousness and automatically go to sleep.
current.PTBR:
[color=192,176,27,255]Vigor[/color] é a barra amarela e descreve energia de curto prazo, o quanto um personagem pode fazer antes de precisar de um breve descanso. Se seu vigor cair muito, você pode pressionar '[color=207,192,178,255]r[/color]' para passar um tempo recuperando-o.

[color=176,101,43,255]Fadiga[/color] é a barra laranja e descreve perda de energia de longo prazo, ela aumenta quando o personagem recupera vigor ao descansar. Para reduzir a fadiga, o personagem precisará dormir, de preferência em uma cama, pressionando '[color=207,192,178,255]R[/color]'. Se a fadiga chegar a 100, o personagem perderá a consciência e dormirá automaticamente.

current.EN:
[color=53,176,43,255]Hunger[/color] defines how much the character is lacking food. If hunger bar drops below 0, starvation level will increase, and hunger level will start dropping from 100 again.

[color=158,27,27,255]Starvation[/color] just like dehydration level reduces every statistic by 2 for every level of starvation. If starvation level reaches 4, the character won't be able to travel on the world map. If starvation level reaches 5, the character will die.
current.PTBR:
[color=53,176,43,255]Fome[/color] define o quanto o personagem está precisando de comida. Se a barra de fome cair abaixo de 0, o nível de inanição aumentará, e o nível de fome começará a cair de 100 novamente.

[color=158,27,27,255]Inanição[/color] assim como o nível de desidratação reduz cada estatística em 2 para cada nível de inanição. Se o nível de inanição atingir 4, o personagem não poderá viajar no mapa-múndi. Se o nível de inanição atingir 5, o personagem morrerá.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Goblins are small greenskin creatures known for their ruthlessness. Some say they are shorter orc cousins. They form tribes and prefer to live in the mountains. Dexterity +3, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sneaking +10

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]A long time ago dark elves were living in the forests with their brethren, but they were corrupted by dark gods. Now they occupy huge underground cities. Their controversial religious practices and rituals make them feared and dreaded. They despise most other races for opposing their rightful place among them.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Intelligence +1, Willpower +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sight range +1

[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Short bow
race.name: Dark elf

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. They feed by drinking the blood of the living to sustain their immortal bodies. Vampires have formed an enclave in the ruins of Black Sun Castle, where they scheme to take over the world and enslave the living like cattle.[/color]

Strength +1, Endurance +2, Intelligence +1
Thirst and hunger is replaced by bloodlust.
Infravision: see in the dark.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Cloak, Hood
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Cloak

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Trolls are huge humanoid beasts. Not many beings of this race are considered smart, but they make up for it with brutal, physical power. Trolls have the strength to tear smaller beings apart in the blink of an eye. They are forever hungry and possess very potent regenerative powers.[/color]

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

[color=155,155,155,255]Orcs are green. Orcs are mean. Orcs want to smash, bash and eat. They form hordes led by the most brutal chieftains of their kind to raid other races for loot. Their physical appearance is second only to trolls and giants.[/color]

Strength +2, Endurance +2
Hit bonus +1 on all weapons

[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Hatchet

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. Their center of power is in the Black Pyramid of Sareth where God Pharaoh Sandaver rules over the dead. The power that allows these beings to defy death is shrouded in mystery.[/color]

Intelligence +2, Willpower +2
Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. They live deep in the jungles of Tar'Var. They are individuals, loners and prefer seclusion over contact with others, as they considering other races untrustworthy. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

Their greed pushes them to challenge dwarves for their territory constantly. From time to time, they organize in hordes that swarm even the human empire.[/color]

Dexterity +3, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sneaking +10

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]A long time ago dark elves were living in the forests with their brethren, but they were corrupted by dark gods. Now they occupy huge underground cities. Dexterity +2, Intelligence +1, Willpower +1
Infravision: see in the dark.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. They feed by drinking the blood of the living to sustain their immortal bodies. Vampires have formed an enclave in the ruins of Black Sun Castle, where they scheme to take over the world and enslave the living like cattle.[/color]

Strength +1, Endurance +2, Intelligence +1
Thirst and hunger is replaced by bloodlust.
Infravision: see in the dark.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Trolls are huge humanoid beasts. Not many beings of this race are considered smart, but they make up for it with brutal, physical power. Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2

[color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. Their center of power is in the Black Pyramid of Sareth where God Pharaoh Sandaver rules over the dead. The power that allows these beings to defy death is shrouded in mystery.[/color]

[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. [color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. They feed by drinking the blood of the living to sustain their immortal bodies. Vampires have formed an enclave in the ruins of Black Sun Castle, where they scheme to take over the world and enslave the living like cattle.[/color]

Strength +1, Endurance +2, Intelligence +1
Thirst and hunger is replaced by bloodlust.
Infravision: see in the dark.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Cloak, Hood
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Cloak
race.name: Vampire

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Trolls are huge humanoid beasts. Not many beings of this race are considered smart, but they make up for it with brutal, physical power. Trolls have the strength to tear smaller beings apart in the blink of an eye. They are forever hungry and possess very potent regenerative powers.[/color]

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Club
race.name: Troll

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Orcs are green. Orcs are mean. Orcs want to smash, bash and eat. They form hordes led by the most brutal chieftains of their kind to raid other races for loot. Their physical appearance is second only to trolls and giants.[/color]

Strength +2, Endurance +2
Hit bonus +1 on all weapons

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Hand axe
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Hatchet
race.name: Orc

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. Their center of power is in the Black Pyramid of Sareth where God Pharaoh Sandaver rules over the dead. The power that allows these beings to defy death is shrouded in mystery.[/color]

Intelligence +2, Willpower +2
Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. They live deep in the jungles of Tar'Var. They are individuals, loners and prefer seclusion over contact with others, as they considering other races untrustworthy. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

[color=155,155,155,255]Humans were the most common being in the world once, but these days are long gone. The population decimated by constant wars is now just a shadow of its former glory. As the War of Worlds has ended, a great empire has been formed, where single human family clings to the seat of power to this day.[/color]

All statistics +1
Gets hungry 50% slower

current.EN:
[color=142,39,194,255]Life Essence[/color] defines how much the character is lacking essence to sustain itself. If life essence drops below 0, the dehydration level will increase, and life essence level will start falling from 100 again. You can regain life essence by dealing death damage to anything that can receive it. Receiving holy damage will reduce life essence gathered!

[color=60,60,60,255]Mortality[/color] level decreases the chance of successful attacks and many other actions by 10%. If the dehydration level reaches 10, the character will die.
current.PTBR:
[color=142,39,194,255]Essência Vital[/color] define quanto o personagem carece de essência para se sustentar. Se a essência vital cair abaixo de 0, o nível de desidratação aumentará, e o nível de essência vital começará a cair de 100 novamente. Você pode recuperar essência vital causando dano de morte a qualquer coisa que possa recebê-lo. Receber dano sagrado reduzirá a essência vital acumulada!

[color=60,60,60,255]Mortalidade[/color] nível diminui a chance de ataques bem-sucedidos e muitas outras ações em 10%. Se o nível de desidratação atingir 10, o personagem morrerá.

Willpower +2

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Goblins are small greenskin creatures known for their ruthlessness. Some say they are shorter orc cousins. They form tribes and prefer to live in the mountains. Dexterity +3, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sneaking +10

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]A long time ago dark elves were living in the forests with their brethren, but they were corrupted by dark gods. Now they occupy huge underground cities. Their controversial religious practices and rituals make them feared and dreaded. They despise most other races for opposing their rightful place among them.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Intelligence +1, Willpower +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sight range +1

[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Short bow
race.name: Dark elf

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. They feed by drinking the blood of the living to sustain their immortal bodies. Vampires have formed an enclave in the ruins of Black Sun Castle, where they scheme to take over the world and enslave the living like cattle.[/color]

Strength +1, Endurance +2, Intelligence +1
Thirst and hunger is replaced by bloodlust.
Infravision: see in the dark.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Cloak, Hood
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Cloak
race.name: Vampire

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Trolls are huge humanoid beasts. Not many beings of this race are considered smart, but they make up for it with brutal, physical power. Trolls have the strength to tear smaller beings apart in the blink of an eye. They are forever hungry and possess very potent regenerative powers.[/color]

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Club
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Club
race.name: Troll

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Orcs are green. Orcs are mean. Orcs want to smash, bash and eat. They form hordes led by the most brutal chieftains of their kind to raid other races for loot. Their physical appearance is second only to trolls and giants.[/color]

Strength +2, Endurance +2
Hit bonus +1 on all weapons

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Hand axe
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Hatchet
race.name: Orc

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. Their center of power is in the Black Pyramid of Sareth where God Pharaoh Sandaver rules over the dead. The power that allows these beings to defy death is shrouded in mystery.[/color]

Intelligence +2, Willpower +2
Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Mask
race.name: Lich

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. They live deep in the jungles of Tar'Var. They are individuals, loners and prefer seclusion over contact with others, as they considering other races untrustworthy. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

current.EN:
Potential determines the maximum level of a skill. You may unlock your potential by training with someone who's more skilled than you.

The sum of all skills potential is the potential of your character and it cannot go over [color=125,200,125,255]{}[/color] right now. As your character reaches middle aged stage for your chosen race, you may unlock additional potential.

You may not reduce your potential after training, so choose your path wisely.
current.PTBR:
O potencial determina o nível máximo de uma habilidade. Você pode desbloquear seu potencial treinando com alguém mais habilidoso que você.

A soma do potencial de todas as habilidades é o potencial do seu personagem e não pode ultrapassar [color=125,200,125,255]{}[/color] no momento. Quando seu personagem atingir a fase de meia-idade para a raça escolhida, você poderá desbloquear potencial adicional.

Você não pode reduzir seu potencial após o treinamento, então escolha seu caminho com sabedoria.

Their greed pushes them to challenge dwarves for their territory constantly. From time to time, they organize in hordes that swarm even the human empire.[/color]

Dexterity +3, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sneaking +10

[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Rags
race.name: Goblin

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]A long time ago dark elves were living in the forests with their brethren, but they were corrupted by dark gods. Now they occupy huge underground cities. Their controversial religious practices and rituals make them feared and dreaded. They despise most other races for opposing their rightful place among them.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Intelligence +1, Willpower +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sight range +1

[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Short bow
race.name: Dark elf

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. They feed by drinking the blood of the living to sustain their immortal bodies. Vampires have formed an enclave in the ruins of Black Sun Castle, where they scheme to take over the world and enslave the living like cattle.[/color]

Strength +1, Endurance +2, Intelligence +1
Thirst and hunger is replaced by bloodlust.
Infravision: see in the dark.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Cloak, Hood
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Cloak
race.name: Vampire

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Trolls are huge humanoid beasts. Not many beings of this race are considered smart, but they make up for it with brutal, physical power. Trolls have the strength to tear smaller beings apart in the blink of an eye. They are forever hungry and possess very potent regenerative powers.[/color]

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Club
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Club
race.name: Troll

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Orcs are green. Orcs are mean. Orcs want to smash, bash and eat. They form hordes led by the most brutal chieftains of their kind to raid other races for loot. Their physical appearance is second only to trolls and giants.[/color]

Strength +2, Endurance +2
Hit bonus +1 on all weapons

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Hand axe
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Hatchet
race.name: Orc

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. Their center of power is in the Black Pyramid of Sareth where God Pharaoh Sandaver rules over the dead. The power that allows these beings to defy death is shrouded in mystery.[/color]

Intelligence +2, Willpower +2
Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Mask

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. They live deep in the jungles of Tar'Var. They are individuals, loners and prefer seclusion over contact with others, as they considering other races untrustworthy. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

current.EN:
Like to do your thing with little consequence? Want to explore the world at your own pace? Build a hut in the forest while the world around you burns to the ground? This game mode is for you.

- Drops all items from backpack and respawns in home settlement after death.
- Your character doesn't age.
- Your character can't die from starvation or dehydration.
- Skills require 200% more effort to advance.
- You can only begin as an orphan.
- Scoring disabled.
current.PTBR:
Gosta de fazer do seu jeito com poucas consequências? Quer explorar o mundo no seu ritmo? Construir uma cabana na floresta enquanto o mundo ao redor arde? Este modo de jogo é para você.

- Solta todos os itens da mochila e renasce no assentamento de origem após a morte.
- Seu personagem não envelhece.
- Seu personagem não pode morrer de fome ou sede.
- Habilidades exigem 200% mais esforço para avançar.
- Você só pode começar como órfão.
- Pontuação desativada.

current.EN:
Do you appreciate things that require a bit of effort to acquire? Do you like the high-stakes combat of traditional roguelikes? Do you wish your existence could change the world in a meaningful way? This is the recommended game mode.

- Permanent character death.
- You can continue in the same world with a new character.
- No penalty to skill gain.
- You can begin as part of an existing family.
current.PTBR:
Aprecia coisas que exigem um pouco de esforço para obter? Gosta do combate de alto risco dos roguelikes tradicionais? Deseja que sua existência possa mudar o mundo de forma significativa? Este é o modo de jogo recomendado.

- Morte permanente do personagem.
- Você pode continuar no mesmo mundo com um novo personagem.
- Sem penalidade no ganho de habilidade.
- Você pode começar como parte de uma família existente.

If you believe meta progression is for scrubs, or you wish to take on the game's highest possible challenge, this is it. Recommended for masochists.

- When you die, the world dies with you.

- Quando você morre, o mundo morre com você.

current.EN:
Sneaking allows characters to walk quietly, unheard by nearby beings, but it does not have any effect if they remain in the line of sight.

Sneaking attempt is performed automatically when walking, and its chance of success is determined by distance from every being and their opposing hearing checks.

Sneaking may also determine if you get noticed while pickpocketing, robbing, and stealing.
current.PTBR:
Furtividade permite que personagens andem silenciosamente, sem serem ouvidos por seres próximos, mas não tem efeito se permanecerem na linha de visão.

A tentativa de furtividade é realizada automaticamente ao andar, e sua chance de sucesso é determinada pela distância de cada ser e seus testes de audição opostos.

A furtividade também pode determinar se você é notado ao praticar furto de bolso, roubo e furto.

current.EN:
Parry property improves the chance to avoid getting hit by an opponent during a basic attack and is an opposite property to Hit. Abilities cannot be parried.

Hit check is performed as follows:
[color=255,246,143,255](Hit + 1d10) / (Parry + 1d10) = Chance to Hit %[/color]
Max chance to parry is 90%.

Parry can occur only 1 (2 with shield) times between attacks, which means performing your attack resets the counter. Both abilities that deal damage and regular attacks reset the counter, and drawing blood is unnecessary.

current.EN:
Resistances cover specific areas of your body and reduce damage received from different sources. There are four major areas where you can get hit, and for each of these locations, only some of the items you wear provide cover.

[color=255,246,143,255]Head (16%)[/color] - covered by items in [color=215,206,123,255]head cloth[/color], [color=215,206,123,255]head armor[/color], and [color=215,206,123,255]amulet[/color] slots.
[color=255,246,143,255]Torso (36%)[/color] - covered by items in [color=215,206,123,255]torso cloth[/color], [color=215,206,123,255]torso armor[/color], [color=215,206,123,255]belt[/color], and [color=215,206,123,255]cloak[/color] slots. 
[color=255,246,143,255]Arms (28%)[/color] - covered by items in [color=215,206,123,255]gloves[/color] and [color=215,206,123,255]both ring[/color] slots.
[color=255,246,143,255]Legs (20%)[/color] - covered by items in [color=215,206,123,255]legs cloth[/color], [color=215,206,123,255]legs armor[/color], and [color=215,206,123,255]boots[/color] slots.

Additionally, wielding a [color=215,206,123,255]shield[/color] in the offhand slot provides resistance to each location mentioned above.

Each resistance point reduces the damage of the corresponding type by 1 point up to minimum damage value.
[color=215,206,123,255]Minimum damage[/color] depends on [color=215,206,123,255]combat disadventage[/color]: attacks from the front deals min. of [color=255,246,143,255]10%[/color] of rolled damage, flanking attacks [color=255,246,143,255]20%[/color] and backstabbing attacks as much as [color=255,246,143,255]30%[/color].

Damage dealt by [color=215,206,123,255]weather[/color] and [color=215,206,123,255]environment conditions[/color] can be reduced to 0 damage by resistance, ignoring minimum damage.
current.PTBR:
Resistências cobrem áreas específicas do seu corpo e reduzem o dano recebido de diferentes fontes. Existem quatro áreas principais onde você pode ser atingido, e para cada uma dessas localizações, apenas alguns dos itens que você usa fornecem cobertura.

[color=255,246,143,255]Cabeça (16%)[/color] - coberta por itens nos espaços de [color=215,206,123,255]tecido de cabeça[/color], [color=215,206,123,255]armadura de cabeça[/color] e [color=215,206,123,255]amuleto[/color].
[color=255,246,143,255]Torso (36%)[/color] - coberto por itens nos espaços de [color=215,206,123,255]tecido de torso[/color], [color=215,206,123,255]armadura de torso[/color], [color=215,206,123,255]cinto[/color] e [color=215,206,123,255]manto[/color].
[color=255,246,143,255]Braços (28%)[/color] - cobertos por itens nos espaços de [color=215,206,123,255]luvas[/color] e [color=215,206,123,255]ambos os anéis[/color].
[color=255,246,143,255]Pernas (20%)[/color] - cobertas por itens nos espaços de [color=215,206,123,255]tecido de pernas[/color], [color=215,206,123,255]armadura de pernas[/color] e [color=215,206,123,255]botas[/color].

Além disso, empunhar um [color=215,206,123,255]escudo[/color] no espaço de mão secundária fornece resistência a cada localização mencionada acima.

Cada ponto de resistência reduz o dano do tipo correspondente em 1 ponto até o valor mínimo de dano.
[color=215,206,123,255]Dano mínimo[/color] depende de [color=215,206,123,255]desvantagem em combate[/color]: ataques de frente causam mínimo de [color=255,246,143,255]10%[/color] do dano rolado, ataques de flanco [color=255,246,143,255]20%[/color] e ataques pelas costas tanto quanto [color=255,246,143,255]30%[/color].

Dano causado por [color=215,206,123,255]clima[/color] e [color=215,206,123,255]condições ambientais[/color] pode ser reduzido a 0 de dano pela resistência, ignorando o dano mínimo.

[color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. They feed by drinking the blood of the living to sustain their immortal bodies. Vampires have formed an enclave in the ruins of Black Sun Castle, where they scheme to take over the world and enslave the living like cattle.[/color]

Strength +1, Endurance +2, Intelligence +1
Thirst and hunger is replaced by bloodlust.
Infravision: see in the dark.

Strength +2, Endurance +2
Hit bonus +1 on all weapons

[color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. Their center of power is in the Black Pyramid of Sareth where God Pharaoh Sandaver rules over the dead. The power that allows these beings to defy death is shrouded in mystery.[/color]

[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. Trolls have the strength to tear smaller beings apart in the blink of an eye. They are forever hungry and possess very potent regenerative powers.[/color]

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

current.EN:
Characters in Soulash 2 are shaped by the skills they use. Each has a maximum potential that will allow you to master up to 5 skills, or mix and combine them without full mastery.

If this is your first playthrough, it's recommended to pick [color=244,247,118,255]Adventuring[/color] skill with a [color=244,247,118,255]Knife[/color] and at least one weapon or magic combat ability to deal with dangers while exploring the world.
current.PTBR:
Personagens em Soulash 2 são moldados pelas habilidades que usam. Cada um tem um potencial máximo que permitirá dominar até 5 habilidades, ou misturá-las e combiná-las sem domínio total.

Se esta é sua primeira partida, recomenda-se escolher a habilidade [color=244,247,118,255]Aventureiro[/color] com uma [color=244,247,118,255]Faca[/color] e pelo menos uma habilidade de combate com arma ou magia para lidar com perigos ao explorar o mundo.

[color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. They feed by drinking the blood of the living to sustain their immortal bodies. Vampires have formed an enclave in the ruins of Black Sun Castle, where they scheme to take over the world and enslave the living like cattle.[/color]

Strength +1, Endurance +2, Intelligence +1
Thirst and hunger is replaced by bloodlust.
Infravision: see in the dark.

[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Cloak
race.name: Vampire

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Trolls are huge humanoid beasts. Not many beings of this race are considered smart, but they make up for it with brutal, physical power. Trolls have the strength to tear smaller beings apart in the blink of an eye. They are forever hungry and possess very potent regenerative powers.[/color]

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Club
race.name: Troll

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Orcs are green. Orcs are mean. Orcs want to smash, bash and eat. They form hordes led by the most brutal chieftains of their kind to raid other races for loot. Their physical appearance is second only to trolls and giants.[/color]

Strength +2, Endurance +2
Hit bonus +1 on all weapons

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Hand axe
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Hatchet
race.name: Orc

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. Their center of power is in the Black Pyramid of Sareth where God Pharaoh Sandaver rules over the dead. The power that allows these beings to defy death is shrouded in mystery.[/color]

Intelligence +2, Willpower +2
Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Mask
race.name: Lich

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. They live deep in the jungles of Tar'Var. They are individuals, loners and prefer seclusion over contact with others, as they considering other races untrustworthy. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

Trolls have the strength to tear smaller beings apart in the blink of an eye. They are forever hungry and possess very potent regenerative powers.[/color]

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

Their center of power is in the Black Pyramid of Sareth where God Pharaoh Sandaver rules over the dead. The power that allows these beings to defy death is shrouded in mystery.[/color]

Intelligence +2, Willpower +2
Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Quarterstaff
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Mask
race.name: Lich

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. They live deep in the jungles of Tar'Var. They are individuals, loners and prefer seclusion over contact with others, as they considering other races untrustworthy. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Dagger, Shirt
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Dagger
race.name: Rasimi

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Dark dwarves are a subrace of dwarves completely corrupted by greed. They prefer to build their incredible keeps very deep below the ground or near volcanoes. Beings of these race are known for being cruel and malevolent.[/color]

Endurance +2
Willpower +2
Infravision: see in the dark.
Tinkerer: double chance to learn new recipe when salvaging.

[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Pickaxe
race.name: Dark dwarf

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Goblins are small greenskin creatures known for their ruthlessness. Some say they are shorter orc cousins. They form tribes and prefer to live in the mountains. Their greed pushes them to challenge dwarves for their territory constantly. From time to time, they organize in hordes that swarm even the human empire.[/color]

Dexterity +3, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sneaking +10

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Rags
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Rags
race.name: Goblin

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]A long time ago dark elves were living in the forests with their brethren, but they were corrupted by dark gods. Now they occupy huge underground cities. Their controversial religious practices and rituals make them feared and dreaded. They despise most other races for opposing their rightful place among them.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Intelligence +1, Willpower +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sight range +1

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Dagger
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Short bow
race.name: Dark elf

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. They feed by drinking the blood of the living to sustain their immortal bodies. Vampires have formed an enclave in the ruins of Black Sun Castle, where they scheme to take over the world and enslave the living like cattle.[/color]

Strength +1, Endurance +2, Intelligence +1
Thirst and hunger is replaced by bloodlust.
Infravision: see in the dark.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Cloak, Hood
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Cloak
race.name: Vampire

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Trolls are huge humanoid beasts. Not many beings of this race are considered smart, but they make up for it with brutal, physical power. Trolls have the strength to tear smaller beings apart in the blink of an eye. They are forever hungry and possess very potent regenerative powers.[/color]

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Club
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Club

Are you ready to retire from your adventuring life?

Accepting such an end to your story will show you the final score and allow your character to remain in the world as part of its simulated history.

If you have adult children or grandchildren, you may continue influencing the world as one of them, retaining their trained skills and items.

Se você tem filhos ou netos adultos, pode continuar influenciando o mundo como um deles, mantendo suas habilidades treinadas e itens.

They feed by drinking the blood of the living to sustain their immortal bodies. Vampires have formed an enclave in the ruins of Black Sun Castle, where they scheme to take over the world and enslave the living like cattle.[/color]

Strength +1, Endurance +2, Intelligence +1
Thirst and hunger is replaced by bloodlust.
Infravision: see in the dark.

race.description:

current.PTBR: Seus inimigos roubaram seu dinheiro e o deixaram para morrer, mas a sorte sorriu para você quando viajantes o encontraram, cuidaram de você até você se recuperar e o levaram para a cidade.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Humans were the most common being in the world once, but these days are long gone. The population decimated by constant wars is now just a shadow of its former glory. Representatives of this race are extremely adaptable to the situation, but their history was marked heavily by external influence. As the War of Worlds has ended, a great empire has been formed, where single human family clings to the seat of power to this day.[/color]

All statistics +1
Gets hungry 50% slower

[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Fishing rod

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Dark dwarves are a subrace of dwarves completely corrupted by greed. They prefer to build their incredible keeps very deep below the ground or near volcanoes. Beings of these race are known for being cruel and malevolent.[/color]

Endurance +2
Willpower +2
Infravision: see in the dark.
Tinkerer: double chance to learn new recipe when salvaging.
